title: Electrical Maintenance Technician
description:
Company Activities:

Our client is part of the circular economy based on wood fibers. In Belgium, the company has three units employing around 600 employees. The plant in Langerbrugge (Ghent) produces high-quality newspaper and magazine paper from 100% recycled paper. Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading global producer of renewable solutions for paper, packaging, pulp, and wood constructions, is looking for an Electrical Maintenance Technician. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining the electrical network up to a voltage level of 150 kV.

Your daily tasks will include:

  • Managing the lighting network.
  • Maintaining fire detection systems.
  • Operating frequency converters (ABB, Siemens, Danfoss).
  • Controlling various types of power switches (Siemens, ABB).

The ideal candidate should:

  • Hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
  • Have several years of experience in a similar role in an industrial production environment.
  • Be passionate about electricity and keep up-to-date with the latest trends in the field.
  • Think pragmatically and solve problems.
  • Plan and organize work effectively, with a focus on achieving results.
  • Communicate in English or Dutch at a good level.

title: Freelance Bid Manager
description:
Our client is an engineering company based in Namur Belgium

Jobomschrijving

Bid Pipeline Management & Monitoring

  • Maintain a consolidated and up-to-date overview of all ongoing tender opportunities (RFIs, RFQs, RFPs) across business units.
  • Develop and manage a structured bid tracking system (CRM or dedicated tool) to monitor:
    • Opportunity status
    • Submission deadlines
    • Key milestones
    • Responsibilities and deliverables
  • Ensure pipeline visibility and reporting for relevant stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify and escalate risks related to bid timelines or deliverables to Area Sales Managers and the Head of Sales.

Bid Coordination & Planning

  • Collaborate closely with Area Sales Managers during the preparation of each tender response.
  • Coordinate bid activities and allocate tasks among internal contributors.
  • Manage communication and information flow between stakeholders involved in the proposal process.
  • Monitor progress against agreed schedules and actively follow up on outstanding contributions.
  • Ensure adherence to submission deadlines and internal governance requirements.

Proposal Development & Content Management

  • Draft and manage common, corporate, and cross-functional proposal sections, including:
    • Company presentations
    • References and case studies
    • Qualifications and certifications
    • Compliance documentation
  • Structure, edit, format, and harmonize proposal content in accordance with customer requirements and tender specifications.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and professionalism across all bid documents.
  • Maintain and continuously improve the bid knowledge library, including:
    • Templates
    • Standard responses
    • Project references
    • CVs
    • Certifications
    • Supporting documentation

Commercial Support

  • Support commercial presentations and bid defense meetings when required.
  • Assist sales teams in preparing customer-facing proposal materials.
  • Contribute to improving bid processes, methodologies, and best practices.

Market Intelligence & Qualification

  • Conduct ongoing monitoring of tender opportunities and procurement platforms.
  • Support bid qualification activities by gathering and organizing relevant information.
  • Monitor market developments and customer requirements to enhance proposal competitiveness.
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve future bidding strategies.

Experience

  • Proven experience in bid management, proposal management, tender coordination, or a similar commercial support role.
  • Experience managing public and/or private sector tenders.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Skills & CompetenciesTechnical Skills

  • Strong proposal writing, editing, and document management skills.
  • Experience with CRM systems and bid management tools.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent document formatting and presentation capabilities.

title: Driver C/CE
description:
Our client has over 100 years of expertise in cleaning and renting high-quality textiles. They provide their services to hospitals, healthcare institutions, and holiday parks in both the Netherlands and Belgium. Known for being accessible, nearby, and highly engaged, they are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining strong relationships with their clients. Joining their team means contributing to a legacy of excellence and reliability in the textile industry.

Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Driver with a passion for delivering excellent service? Our client is looking for dedicated Drivers to join their team in Oedelem (Oostkamp/Bruges). This is an exciting opportunity to work with a company that values reliability, professionalism, and teamwork.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Operate vehicles (C and CE licenses) on fixed routes from Monday to Friday.
  • Drive 50% of the time and assist with loading/unloading 50% of the time.
  • Ensure timely and safe delivery of goods.
  • Handle physically demanding tasks, including moving heavy carts.
  • Maintain clear communication and adhere to schedules.

Profile Description

Our client is seeking Drivers who meet the following criteria:

  • Valid C or CE driving license, medical clearance, and Code 95 certification.
  • Excellent command of Dutch, French, or English.
  • Physically fit and capable of handling heavy loads.
  • Reliable, with a strong work ethic and minimal absenteeism.
  • Able to provide good references.

title: Industrial Electrician
description:
About the Company:

Our client is a respected organization where quality, safety, and teamwork are core values. As a VCA**-certified company, they are committed to providing excellent service to their clients while fostering a growth-oriented and supportive environment for their employees. They are looking for individuals who share their passion for excellence and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

At our client’s company, quality and safety are at the heart of everything they do (VCA**-certified). Equally important, however, are their people. Due to their continued growth, they are looking for a motivated Industrial Electrician to make a real difference within their organization.

Your Role:

  • Perform on-site interventions at the client’s location in case of issues.
  • Take responsibility for repairing reported problems at the client’s site.
  • Verify that the actions taken result in the optimal functioning of the equipment.
  • Ensure all work is delivered with a focus on safety, efficiency, quality, and timing.
  • Act as the main point of contact for the client on-site and provide internal reports to the project manager.
  • Collaborate effectively, whether working independently or as part of a team.

Profile Description: 

A technical education in an electrical field (or equivalent through experience).

Strong communication skills in Dutch or English.

A customer-friendly attitude: You prioritize client values and ensure commitments are met.

A flexible mindset: You adapt your approach as needed to achieve goals and handle changes effectively.

A valid driver’s license (Category B).

VCA and BA4/5 certifications are a plus, but not mandatory.

title: Bus Mechanic
description:
Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.
  • Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.
  • Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.
  • Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.
  • Participate in technical training courses provided by various bus manufacturers.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

You communicate well in English, Dutch, or French.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

Experience working on trucks is an advantage; experience with buses is even better.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

title: Captain for Tugboat
description:
Company Activities:

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a skilled Captain for Tugboat looking for an exciting opportunity to showcase your expertise? Join our client’s dynamic team and navigate the waters of northern France and Belgium. Your primary mission will be to provide essential support to a dredging pontoon, ensuring smooth operations and safe passage through these regions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Navigate and operate the tugboat efficiently in collaboration with dredging operations.
  • Ensure the mechanical upkeep of the tugboat, supported by the client’s team of technicians.
  • Maintain tidiness and order on board, ensuring a safe and pleasant environment.
  • Coordinate with French-speaking and Flemish-speaking teams to ensure seamless communication and operations.

Profile Description:

Our client is seeking an independent and responsible individual to take on the role of Captain for Tugboat. The ideal candidate will possess:

  • A strong mechanical knowledge, essential for the maintenance and operation of the tugboat.
  • CRR holder credentials.
  • A driving licence and access to a car for easy mobility.
  • A B licence (river) and A licence (river coastal) to navigate various waterways.
  • Proficiency in English, French, or Dutch to effectively communicate with diverse teams.

title: Customer Service Coordinator
description:
Our client, a leading international service provider operating in highly time-sensitive and mission-critical environments, is looking for a Customer Service Coordinator to strengthen their global operations team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Service Coordinator, you become the primary point of contact for customers and international partners worldwide. You will combine customer service excellence with operational coordination, ensuring every shipment is executed flawlessly from start to finish.This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working in an international setting, solving problems under pressure, and coordinating complex logistics operations.Customer Service Excellence

  • Act as the main contact person for customers via phone and email.
  • Provide proactive updates throughout the shipment lifecycle.
  • Build strong relationships with customers, internal teams, and international offices.
  • Resolve customer queries regarding shipments, documentation, customs requirements, transit times, and service options.
  • Manage escalations and ensure rapid, customer-focused solutions.
  • Translate customer expectations into clear operational instructions.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Verify shipping documentation and customs requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with international transportation regulations.
  • Follow detailed operational procedures and quality standards.
  • Support the handling of specialized shipments requiring additional care and attention.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Recent graduates with a strong customer-oriented mindset are encouraged to apply.
  • Strong customer focus and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word).
  • Professional level in Dutch, French and English

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Customer Service Specialist to join an international and innovative organization. In this role, you will combine customer focus, analytical skills, and digital tools to ensure a smooth and proactive customer experience. Your main focus will be on managing customer orders, following up on quotations, and building long-term customer relationships.

Our client is an internationally renowned industrial organization and market leader in innovative technical solutions for customers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

We are looking for a Customer Service Specialist to join an international and innovative organization.   • Actively contribute to process improvement and digitalization initiatives.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
  • Initial experience in customer service, sales support, customer experience, or a similar role.
  • Strong communication skills in Dutch and English. Knowledge of French is an advantage.
  • Analytical mindset and comfortable working with digital tools and MS Office.
  • Customer-oriented, structured, and solution-driven.
  • Proactive attitude with the ability to take initiative and think alongside customers and colleagues.
  • Comfortable working in an environment where change, innovation, and continuous improvement are key priorities.

title: IT Coordinator (Brussels)

title: Mold Technician
description:

title: Lab Support Operator (talentpool)
description:

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are seeking motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

Good to KnowYou’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:

  • You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
  • Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
  • You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
  • Your attention to detail is unmatched.
  • Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

title: Student Bar / Animator karting 18+
description:
Hoe ziet jouw dag eruit?

Je start je dag met een controle van de werkruimte en zorgt ervoor dat alles netjes en klaarstaat voor de klanten. Je vult de frigo's aan, controleert of de karts volledig opgeladen zijn en treft de nodige voorbereidingen voor de eerste onthalen van de dag.

Zodra de eerste klanten arriveren, verwelkom je hen met een glimlach. Je helpt klanten aan de bar, geeft hen de nodige uitleg over hun bezoek en zorgt ervoor dat zij goed geïnformeerd aan hun race kunnen beginnen. Dankzij jouw klantgerichte aanpak beleven bezoekers een vlotte en aangename ervaring.

Doorheen de dag sta je klaar om vragen te beantwoorden, klanten verder te helpen en ervoor te zorgen dat alles op rolletjes loopt. Aan het einde van je werkdag sluit je de activiteiten netjes af, zorg je voor de nodige opkuis en laat je de werkplek verzorgd achter voor je collega's.

  • Je bent een student van 18 jaar of ouder.
  • Je beschikt over eigen vervoer of een betrouwbare manier om je vlot en stipt naar de locatie te verplaatsen.
  • Je hebt een goede tot vloeiende kennis van het Nederlands, zodat je vlot kunt communiceren met zowel klanten als collega's.
  • Je bent computervaardig en hebt voldoende technisch inzicht om te werken met reservatiesystemen en klanten correct op te starten.
  • Je bent ongeveer beschikbaar 2 dagen in de week en 1 dag in het weekend.

title: Flexi medewerker ontbijt B&B

title: Medewerker hittebehandeling bedwants
description:
• Werk je graag zelfstandig en neem je met vertrouwen verantwoordelijkheid op?
  • Zoek je een job waarin geen enkele dag hetzelfde is en waarbij je probleemoplossend te werk gaat?
  • Wil je expert worden in een nichevakgebied waarvoor slechts een beperkt aantal specialisten actief zijn?

Wanneer een hotel, zorginstelling of opvangcentrum geconfronteerd wordt met een mogelijke bedwantsenbesmetting, is snel en deskundig handelen cruciaal. Daar kom jij in beeld.

Als Bedwantsenspecialist ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opsporen, analyseren en bestrijden van bedwantsen. Je voert inspecties uit, begeleidt warmtebehandelingen en zorgt ervoor dat klanten opnieuw met een gerust hart hun kamers kunnen gebruiken.

Dit is geen klassieke functie in ongediertebestrijding. Je specialiseert je volledig in één expertisegebied en werkt aan grotere projecten waarbij kwaliteit, nauwkeurigheid en zelfstandigheid centraal staan.

Geen dag verloopt hetzelfde.

De ene dag voer je een inspectie uit in een hotel en plaats je monitoringmateriaal om mogelijke activiteit op te sporen. De andere dag ben je bezig met een uitgebreide warmtebehandeling waarbij volledige kamers of verdiepingen worden aangepakt.

Je staat onder meer in voor:

  • Inspecteren van kamers, gebouwen en accommodaties
  • Detecteren en analyseren van mogelijke bedwantsenactiviteit
  • Adviseren van klanten over preventie en opvolging
  • Uitvoeren van professionele bestrijdingsbehandelingen
  • Installeren en opvolgen van warmtebehandelingsapparatuur
  • Registreren van meetresultaten en kwaliteitscontroles
  • Opstellen van interventieverslagen
  • Uitvoeren van nacontroles en opvolgbezoeken

Sommige projecten duren één dag, andere meerdere dagen na elkaar. Je krijgt daarbij veel autonomie om jouw opdrachten zelfstandig uit te voeren.

Voor deze functie zoeken we vooral de juiste persoon, niet het perfecte diploma.

Je bent iemand die:

  • Zelfstandig beslissingen durft nemen
  • Nauwkeurig werkt en oog heeft voor detail
  • Technisch inzicht heeft of affiniteit voelt met technische toepassingen
  • Klantgericht en professioneel communiceert
  • Discreet omgaat met gevoelige situaties
  • Flexibel is naar verplaatsingen
  • Fysiek werk niet uit de weg gaat
  • Goed kan functioneren zonder voortdurende begeleiding

Een achtergrond in techniek, facilitaire diensten, onderhoud, veiligheidsdiensten, hospitality of ongediertebestrijding kan interessant zijn, maar is absoluut geen vereiste.

De motivatie om deze expertise aan te leren is veel belangrijker.

title: Ontbijtmedewerker (deeltijds 26u) in Silt
description:
Ben jij een vroege vogel die graag zorgt voor een warme start van de dag? Voor Silt Hotel in Middelkerke zoeken we een enthousiaste deeltijdse ontbijtmedewerker.

Met jouw glimlach, oog voor detail en gastvrije aanpak zorg je ervoor dat onze gasten ontspannen aan hun dag beginnen. Je houdt van contact met mensen, werkt graag in een verzorgd tempo en steekt zonder probleem de handen uit de mouwen.

Silt Hotel is een stijlvol viersterrenhotel op een unieke locatie aan zee, in het hart van Middelkerke. Het hotel combineert hedendaags design met warme gastvrijheid en een ontspannen sfeer.

Silt maakt deel uit van C-Hotels Group, een groeiende hotelgroep waar kwaliteit, klantvriendelijkheid en een fijne beleving voor gasten én medewerkers centraal staan.

Wat ga je doen?

Als ontbijtmedewerker zorg jij voor een warme en verzorgde start van de dag voor onze gasten:

  • Je staat in voor het klaarmaken en opdienen van het ontbijt in de ontbijtruimte

  • Je ontvangt gasten vriendelijk en helpt hen waar nodig tijdens het ontbijt

  • Je ondersteunt bij eenvoudige keuken- en voorbereidingswerken

  • Je zorgt voor een nette en gastvrije uitstraling van het ontbijtgedeelte

  • Je werkt nauw samen met je collega’s om alles vlot te laten verlopen

  • Je bent gastvrij, vriendelijk en verantwoordelijk

  • Je hebt oog voor detail en werkt netjes

  • Je kan zelfstandig werken en organiseren, maar bent ook een echte teamplayer

  • Je hebt reeds ervaring in de ontbijtservice/horeca

  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en bereid te werken in weekends en op feestdagen

title: Brussels Pfizer Clinical Research Unit, Participants and Recruitment and Engagement Lead
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Brussels Pfizer Clinical Research Unit, Participants and Recruitment and Engagement Lead (BR PCRU Participants and Recruitment and Engagement Lead) provides strategic and operational leadership for participants recruitment at the Brussels Pfizer Clinical Research Unit, ensuring high-quality service delivery. The Lead ensures ethical, inclusive, and participant-centred identification, engagement, pre-screening, and enrolment of healthy volunteers and special populations while safeguarding participants' rights, safety and privacy. The role supports timely, compliant study delivery and translates site and portfolio priorities into data driven recruitment strategies aligned with R&D goals. The Lead builds high-performing teams that responsibly use approved AI, automation, risk based strategy and analytics to improve targeting, forecasting, database management, and decision-making while maintaining human oversight, ethics, and participants data privacy.

Key accountabilities include:

  • local recruitment strategy and delivery;
  • study feasibility and portfolio forecasting;
  • enrolment-risk management;
  • participant experience and ethical recruitment;
  • team, capacity and budget leadership;
  • recruitment data quality and privacy compliance;
  • vendor/channel performance;
  • digital enablement and continuous improvement;
  • local cross-functional coordination; and
  • cross-site sharing of practice through PCRU governance

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Recruitment Governance and Resource Oversight:

  • Capacity and resource planning
  • Colleague and contractor allocation
  • Recruitment channel and vendor management
  • Advertising, outreach and budget management
  • Workload, training and competency oversight
  • Team Performance management
  • Inspection and audit readiness
  • Business continuity to sustain critical recruitment activities during operational disruption or resource constraints.
  • Database health and participant-contact quality supporting privacy, data quality and positive participant engagement.

Strategic Participant Recruitment & Portfolio Delivery

  • Recruitment strategy: Lead the development and delivery of the Brussels PCRU participant recruitment strategy in line with site priorities and the resource parameters established by the Brussels Site Head.
  • Predictive planning and protocol feasibility: Shape early study strategy by assessing recruitment feasibility, developing evidence-based plans aligned with timelines, quality and budget, and proactively mitigating or escalating risks.
  • Compliance, ethics and process improvement: Develop, implement and continuously improve applicable local procedures, ensuring team compliance with relevant Pfizer policies, SOPs and work instructions.
  • Participant data stewardship: Ensure recruitment data are collected, maintained, accessed and used in accordance with privacy requirements, consent provisions, Pfizer standards and defined data-owner and data-steward accountabilities.

Digital Innovation, Automation & Responsible Adoption

  • Digitalization and automation opportunities: Identify high-value opportunities to simplify processes, increase efficiency and improve operational outcomes through appropriate digital t...

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in life science, health-related, data science, or healthcare administration discipline is required.
  • Clinical Experience: Minimum of 15 years of experience in clinical trial operations or participant recruitment, with at least 7 years within a pharmaceutical company or a Contract Research Organization (CRO) environment.
  • Digital & Analytics Literacy: Demonstrated experience evaluating, adopting, or implementing advanced digital systems, automated databases, or AI-enabled tools to optimize operations, analyze datasets, and support executive-level business decisions.
  • Leadership Track Record: Minimum of 5 years of experience leading teams, managing personnel, directing complex operational processes, and navigating organizational change management.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strategic & Systems Thinking: Outstanding capability to translate complex operational data, digital dashboards, and AI-generated models into clear, actionable recruitment strategies and executive-level recommendations.
  • Regulatory Mastery: Thorough and deep understanding of Phase I clinical operations, ICH-GCP, European and Belgian clinical trial regulations, and data privacy laws (GDPR).
  • Stakeholder Influence: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to lead and align cross-functional, multi-disciplinary stakeholder groups behind strategic goals.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong, proactive risk-management capability, with expertise in scenario modeling, continuous operational improvement methodologies, and structured root-cause analysis.

title: Chef Gerant seniors - 38u Heuvelland
description:

Als verzorgende thuiszorg (zorgkundige)  geef je zorg en ondersteuning aan klanten in hun thuisomgeving. Samen met collega's ben je verantwoordelijk voor klanten in de regio.

  • Lichaamsverzorging van de klant.
  • Boodschappen doen en maaltijden bereiden (koken, broodmaaltijd, enz.).
  • Enkele huishoudelijke taken uitvoeren (strijken, wassen).
  • Luisteren naar en ondersteunen van de klant, met aandacht voor psychosociale noden en zelfredzaamheid.

Het gaat om een contract van bepaalde duur van 6 maanden. 

 Je werkt tussen 24 en 38 uur per week. Het uurrooster is bespreekbaar, maar je kan zeker werken op:

  • maandagnamiddag (tot 16u30)
  • woensdagnamiddag en/of vrijdagnamiddag
  • Diploma als zorgkundige / verzorgende of gelijkwaardig (zie www.familiehulp.be/diploma).
  • Je houdt van sociaal contact en communiceert vlot.
  • Betrouwbaarheid en respect voor privacy zijn voor jou vanzelfsprekend.
  • Bereidheid om avond- en weekendwerk in beurtrol te doen.
  • Eigen vervoer (auto of elektrische fiets).

title: F&B Manager
description:
Deze internationale speler binnen de hotelbranche staat bekend om stijlvolle designhotels, een eigentijdse uitstraling en service van topkwaliteit. Elk hotel combineert moderne, inspirerende ruimtes met een persoonlijke gastbeleving, waarbij alles draait om het creëren van een echte wow-ervaring.

Teamwork, waardering en persoonlijke groei staan centraal. Initiatief en creativiteit worden aangemoedigd, ideeën krijgen alle ruimte en je komt terecht in een dynamische, internationale werkomgeving waar mensen samen het verschil maken.

Voor de opening van een nieuw lifestylehotel in Brussel zijn we op zoek naar een enthousiaste F&B Manager die mee zijn of haar stempel wil drukken op dit nieuwe verhaal.

Als F&B manager ben je een groot onderdeel van het hotel. Hierbij draag je de verantwoordelijkheid over de dagelijkse werking van de verschillende F&B-outlets binnen het hotel

  • je stuurt een team van ongeveer 15 medewerkers aan en je staat in voor de rekrutering, onboarding, coaching en ontwikkeling van je medewerkers
  • je bent aanwezig op de werkvloer en waakt over een uitstekende service en gastbeleving
  • je helpt mee om het nieuwe concept mee verder uit te bouwen en op de kaart te zetten in Brussel
  • je denkt mee over het F&B-aanbod
  • je werkt mee aan de ontwikkeling en organisatie van events
  • je draagt de administratieve verantwoordelijkheden van de afdeling: uurroosters, budgetten, bestellingen, rapporteringen aan management
  • je onderhoudt contacten met lokale leveranciers en werkt nauw samen met de andere hotelafdelingen
  • je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de General Manager

Als F&B Manager ben je de drijvende kracht achter de verschillende F&B-outlets van het hotel. Je combineert een sterke operationele aanwezigheid met het aansturen van je team en krijgt de ruimte om het nieuwe concept verder vorm te geven.

  • je hebt relevante ervaring binnen Food & Beverage en hospitality, bij voorkeur in een hotelomgeving
  • je hebt ervaring in het aansturen, coachen en motiveren van teams en bent een sterke people manager
  • je combineert een hands-on mentaliteit met een goed organisatorisch en commercieel inzicht
  • je kent de Brusselse markt en begrijpt hoe je een nieuw hospitalityconcept lokaal kan positioneren
  • je bent ondernemend, proactief en krijgt energie van het uitbouwen van een nieuw project
  • je hebt oog voor trends binnen F&B, events en design en denkt graag mee over vernieuwende concepten
  • je bent betrouwbaar, communicatief sterk en weet mensen op een natuurlijke manier mee te krijgen
  • je bent flexibel ingesteld en begrijpt dat een operationele hospitalityfunctie een zekere flexibiliteit qua werkuren vraagt
  • je spreekt vlot Engels; kennis van het Frans is een troef
  • je woont bij voorkeur in Brussel of de directe omgeving en hebt een goede kennis van de Belgische hospitalitymarkt en sociale wetgeving

title: F&B manager - hotellerie
description:
Dit viersterrenhotel in Brussel opende recent zijn deuren en onderscheidt zich door een frisse, moderne uitstraling. Met meer dan 200 kamers richt het hotel zich voornamelijk op een zakelijk publiek, al weten ook steeds meer leisuregasten hun weg naar het hotel te vinden.

De F&B-afdeling omvat een restaurant, verschillende meetingfaciliteiten en een uitgebreid ontbijtaanbod. Om de dagelijkse werking verder te versterken en te professionaliseren, zijn we op zoek naar een ervaren F&B Manager die de afdeling operationeel mee in goede banen leidt.

Het hotel maakt deel uit van een internationale hotelgroep met vestigingen in verschillende Europese landen. De organisatie combineert een ondernemende aanpak met een sterke focus op kwaliteit, professionele dienstverlening en een aangename gastervaring.

Als F&B Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse operationele werking van de F&B-afdeling. Je bent sterk aanwezig op de werkvloer en neemt een actieve rol op in zowel de restaurant- als keukenwerking.

  • je neemt de operationele leiding over de verschillende F&B-activiteiten binnen het hotel
  • je stuurt het F&B-team (25 personen) aan en zorgt voor een vlotte dagelijkse werking
  • je brengt structuur en efficiëntie in de afdeling en optimaliseert bestaande processen
  • je waakt over de kwaliteit van de service, gerechten en algemene gastbeleving
  • je werkt nauw samen met de keuken en volgt de dagelijkse keukenorganisatie en administratie op
  • je coacht, motiveert en ontwikkelt je medewerkers en bouwt aan een sterke teamdynamiek
  • je bewaakt de personeelsplanning, bestellingen, kosten en budgetten van de keuken en de zaal

We zoeken een sterke F&B-professional die de hotellerie door en door kent en zich thuis voelt in een verantwoordelijke rol:

  • je hebt relevante ervaring binnen F&B in de hotellerie, bij voorkeur in een leidinggevende functie
  • je beschikt over een sterke operationele kennis van zowel restaurant- als keukenwerking
  • je hebt ervaring met het aansturen en ontwikkelen van teams
  • je bent een echte hands-on people manager die graag aanwezig is op de werkvloer
  • je hebt oog voor kwaliteit, efficiëntie en een optimale gastbeleving
  • je bent organisatorisch sterk en weet structuur te brengen in een dynamische omgeving
  • je beschikt over een goed financieel inzicht en hebt ervaring met budgetten, kostencontrole en personeelsplanning
  • je bent communicatief sterk, besluitvaardig en neemt graag initiatief
  • je bent flexibel ingesteld en hebt geen probleem met regelmatige avonduren

title: Verzorgende avondzorg - regio Zuiderkempen (deeltijds)
description:
Familiehulp ondersteunt mensen in hun dagelijks leven, met aandacht voor zorg, welzijn en huishouden.

Binnen onze dienstverlening avondzorg geef je zorg en ondersteuning aan klanten in hun thuisomgeving. Met jouw zorg, aandacht en betrokkenheid help je hen om de dag rustig af te sluiten en comfortabel de nacht in te gaan.

Als verzorgende avondzorg (zorgkundige) werk je zelfstandig in je eigen regio en vorm je samen met je collega's een hecht team.

Jouw taken bestaan onder meer uit:

  • Het avondmaal bereiden en ondersteuning geven bij de maaltijd.
  • Klanten voorbereiden voor de nacht, zoals hulp bij de persoonlijke verzorging, het aantrekken van nachtkledij en verplaatsingen in de woning.
  • Een luisterend oor geven, psychosociale ondersteuning geven en klanten stimuleren om zo zelfstandig mogelijk te blijven.

Je werkt 24 of 28 uur per week. Op weekdagen werk je van 16.00 tot 20.00. Eén of twee keer per week werk je ook in de namiddag van 12.00-16.00. Je bent bereid om minstens 1 keer per maand op woensdag te werken vanwege het maandelijks overleg.  

Je kan je vlot verplaatsen naar Westerlo, Herselt, Hulshout, Geel, Meerhout en Laakdal.

Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring als opvoeder. 

  • Diploma Verzorgende of gelijkwaardig (zie www.familiehulp.be/diploma).
  • Je houdt van sociaal contact en communiceert vlot.
  • Betrouwbaarheid en respect voor privacy zijn voor jou vanzelfsprekend.
  • Eigen vervoer (auto).

title: Operations Planning Officer
description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Our Operations department is currently looking for an Operations Planning Officer. As Operations Planning Officer you will be responsible for the daily and weekly operations planning, optimizing the TAT and maintaining the actual standards. You will also follow up on the planning execution and making adjustments in order to achieve the OTD and TAT targets and develop performance standards for our maintenance activities. Your role:

  • Plan workshop activities, in line with decisions and prioritizations made with the Operations Manager & Operations Planning Manager to meet delivery dates (OTD) and TATs objectives;
  • Distribute the schedule to Operations Shift Managers and Team Leaders;
  • Verify schedule execution within workflows and inform the Operations Manager, Operations Shift Managers, and Team Leaders of any deviations to ensure objectives are met;
  • Participate in defining induction slots with the Operations Planning Manager;
  • Participate in network planning initiatives;
  • Analyze and summarize daily operational performance for the Operations Manager and Operations Shift Managers;
  • Participate in continuous improvement projects and stay informed about Safran standards related to your role.

Your profile:

  • Bachelor degree, or similar by experience
  • Good language skills (English, French and Dutch)
  • Technical background with good engine knowledge
  • General knowledge of quality systems
  • Advanced IT skills (advanced Excel and Power BI)
  • Collaborative team player with strong communication skills
  • Adaptable, results-driven, and customer-focused
  • Outstanding analytical and problem-solving abilities

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

title: Teamleider Internationale Verhuizingen
description:
Teamleider Internationale Verhuizingen | Teamleider Logistiek Operations | Team Lead International Relocation | Operations Supervisor Government Logistics | People Manager Moving & Logistiek | Antwerpen (Deurne)

Steek jij graag de handen uit de mouwen, los je problemen op met gezond boerenverstand en krijg je mensen makkelijk mee? Voor een internationale speler in government logistics en international relocation in Deurne (Antwerpen) zoeken we een Teamleider Internationale Verhuizingen met een sterke people manager in zich.

Het eerste jaar draai je volop mee in de operationele werking en leer je deze zeer specifieke sector grondig kennen. Het team werkt al zelfstandig, dus je hoeft niet meteen de klassieke teamleider te zijn. Wel ben je het aanspreekpunt waar collega’s op kunnen rekenen en groei je stap voor stap in je leidinggevende rol. Een functie met impact, een aantrekkelijk loonpakket en een uitgebreid leiderschapstraject.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je volgt hands-on inbound verhuisdossiers van militair personeel op en leert zo de procedures tot in de puntjes kennen
  • Je beheert mee een drukke shared mailbox en zorgt dat niets blijft liggen
  • Je bewaakt de correcte en tijdige verwerking van dossiers volgens de geldende kwaliteitsnormen
  • Je ondersteunt en coacht je collega’s en helpt nieuwe coördinatoren op weg
  • Je stelt mee prioriteiten, zeker tijdens de drukke zomermaanden
  • Je volgt KPI’s op en denkt actief mee over procesverbetering
  • Je onderhoudt contacten met externe agenten, Transportation Service Providers, military booking offices en militaire klanten
  • Een bachelordiploma of gelijkwaardig denkniveau
  • Ervaring in een leidinggevende of coördinerende rol binnen logistiek, transport, relocation of operations is een troef
  • Een echte hands-on mentaliteit en de wil om veel bij te leren
  • Leidinggevende capaciteiten en een coachende, open houding
  • Sterk probleemoplossend, met een flinke dosis gezond boerenverstand
  • Zeer stressbestendig, ook wanneer de mailbox overloopt
  • Uitstekende communicatie in Nederlands en Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk
  • Een digitale reflex en interesse in de internationale moving industry
  • Je begrijpt dat de zomer de piekperiode is en een lange vakantie dan niet haalbaar is

Vi søger dansktalende kundeservicemedarbejdere til en international virksomhed i Sofia.

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling med arbejdstid mandag–fredag kl. 10.00–19.00

  • Fri i weekenderne til at opleve Sofia og resten af Bulgarien

  • Du taler dansk på et højt professionelt niveau og kan kommunikere på engelsk

  • Har lyst til at bo og arbejde i udlandet

  • Er nysgerrig, fleksibel og klar til nye oplevelser

Uanset om du er i starten af din karriere, ønsker et miljøskifte eller drømmer om at prøve noget helt nyt, kan dette være muligheden for dig.

  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 2. studenog 2026. godine. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 7 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il posto di lavoro
  • 1 collaboratore/collaboratrice professionale – pedagogista in lingua italiana – orario completo, a tempo determinato (supplenza) con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici
CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformita' all'articolo 29, comma 1 a) del Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20):
  • laurea
  • padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana
2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 2 novembre 2026.

title: KONOBAR M/Ž

title: TERENSKI SERVISER/KA
description:
Terenski serviser (m/ž)

Ključni zadaci i odgovornosti:

  • izvođenje servisnih radova u tvrtki i na terenu, na uređajima tvrtke RASCO i na ostalim uređajima koje tvrtka RASCO zastupa i distribuira
  • remont strojeva preuzetih od kupaca
  • izvođenje osnovne obuke za upravljanje Rasco strojevima i uređajima, i onima koje tvrtka RASCO zastupa
  • prijava nesukladnosti prikupljenih sa terena
  • unos podataka i korekcija u baze podataka kojima raspolaže servis
  • vođenje točnih zapisa vezanih za servisne radne naloge
  • kontrola tehničke ispravnosti i održavanje osobnih, dostavnih i teretnih vozila tvrtke

Traženi profil kandidata:

  • SSS tehničkog usmjerenja (automehaničar, autoelektričar, elektromonter itd.)
  • Poželjno 1 - 3 godina radnog iskustvu u sličnim poslovima, ali razmotriti ćemo i kandidate bez radnog iskustva, a koji su spremni proći intenzivnu obuku namijenjenu serviserima početnicima
  • Engleski ili njemački jezik (osnovna razina)
  • Korištenje računalom i MS Office aplikacijama (osnovno)
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorija
  • Sklonost terenskom radu
  • Odgovoran pristup radnim zadacima
  • Sklonost timskom radu i fleksibilnost u poslu

Što nudimo:

  • Početnu plaću sukladno prethodnom iskustvu uz jasno definiranu mogućnost povećanja primanja nakon savladavanja zahtjeva radnog mjesta
  • Naknade troškova prijevoza na posao i s posla, dodatak za topli obrok i radne rezultate kao i isplata pripadajućih dnevnica i terenskog dodatka i prekovremenog rada na terenu
  • Ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad od 3 mjeseca
  • Mentora i sustavno praćenje napretka s ciljem osiguravanja podrške i uspješno uvođenje u posao
  • Dodatne edukacije vezane uz specifičnosti radnog mjesta i edukacije namijenjene osobnom razvoju
  • Radno okružje s visokom razinom odgovornosti te rad sa iskusnim stručnjacima u navedenom području

Mjesto rada: Kalinovac, Koprivničko-križevačka županija Molimo pošaljite nam svoju prijavu i životopis najkasnije do 30.11.2026. godine.

title: STROJAR/KA SUSTAVA GRIJANJA I HLAĐENJA

title: PRODAJNI/A SAVJETNIK/CA – PRODAJA SOLARNIH ELEKTRANA
description: TERENSKI/A PRODAJNI/A PREDSTAVNIK/CA ZA SOLARNE ELEKTRANE Green Bean traži prodajnu osobu za aktivno pronalaženje kupaca solarnih elektrana, prvenstveno vlasnika obiteljskih kuća. Kako izgleda posao? Glavninu rada čine terenski obilasci sela i manjih mjesta u okolici Zagreba. Obilazite dodijeljeno područje, neposredno pristupate vlasnicima kuća i započinjete razgovore o mogućnosti ugradnje solarne elektrane. Važan dio posla čine kontakti bez prethodno dogovorenog sastanka. Očekujemo da samostalno stvarate nove prodajne prilike te zainteresirane kupce pratite od prvog razgovora do ugovaranja. Glavni poslovi: • planiranje i obilazak dodijeljenog područja • osobno kontaktiranje vlasnika kuća i predstavljanje ponude • prepoznavanje interesa i prikupljanje podataka potrebnih za izradu ponude • dogovaranje daljnjih sastanaka i tehničkih obilazaka • prezentacija ponuda te redoviti telefonski, e-mail i osobni kontakt s kupcima do njihove odluke • vođenje evidencije kontakata i prodajnih aktivnosti • suradnja s tehničkim i operativnim timom Koga tražimo? Osobu kojoj odgovara svakodnevni teren, koja može samostalno započeti razgovor s nepoznatom osobom i ustrajno pratiti prodajne prilike. Važno nam je kako pristupate kupcu, slušate njegove potrebe i postupate nakon odbijanja. Prednost imaju kandidati s dokazivim iskustvom u samostalnom pronalaženju i pridobivanju novih kupaca, osobito kroz neposrednu terensku prodaju. Iskustvo sa solarnim elektranama ili tehničkim proizvodima predstavlja prednost, ali nije uvjet. Osiguravamo edukaciju o solarnim elektranama i našem prodajnom procesu. Obavezni su vozačka dozvola B kategorije i spremnost na svakodnevnu vožnju i terenski rad. title: RADNIK NA ODRŽAVANJU - ELEKTRIČAR(M/Ž)
description:
O NAMA

Bjelin Ogulin 2 d.o.o. dio je hrvatsko-švedske Bjelin grupacije, jednog od vodećih europskih proizvođača inovativnih drvenih podova. Usmjereni smo na visokotehnološku proizvodnju i razvoj održivih rješenja od drva, spajajući lokalnu stručnost s globalnim standardima kvalitete. Naš tim čine motivirani i stručni profesionalci različitih profila – od proizvodnih i tehničkih do inženjerskih i stručnih administrativnih funkcija – koje povezuje zajednička strast prema inovacijama, kvaliteti i kontinuiranom unapređenju procesa. Trenutno intenzivno ulažemo u izgradnju najsuvremenijeg pogona za proizvodnju podova u Ogulinu te širimo kapacitete kroz nove proizvodne linije za Woodura podne obloge. Paralelno s razvojem proizvodnje, sustavno jačamo organizaciju kroz razvoj tehničkih, logističkih, administrativnih i ostalih ključnih podržavajućih funkcija. U nadolazećem razdoblju fokusirani smo na zapošljavanje, edukaciju i osposobljavanje zaposlenika svih profila, s ciljem osiguravanja visoke razine kvalitete procesa, proizvoda i održivog rasta cijele organizacije.

TVOJI KLJUČNI ZADACI

  • Održavanje i popravak radnih linija, strojeva i pribora,

  • Remont postrojenja,

  • Vođenje brige o elektroopremi,

  • Obavljanje sitnih popravaka i čišćenja elektro dijelova uređaja,

  • Sudjelovanje u demontaži i montaži elektroopreme prilikom redovitih i interventnih servisa i pri otklanjanju kvarova,

  • Praćenje rada uređaja i strojeva, ukazivanje na trenutne probleme i sudjelovanje u otklanjanju istih,

  • Pregled elektroopreme prema uputama (svakodnevno, tjedno, mjesečno) te ažurira iste.

OČEKUJEMO

  • SSS tehničkog ili drugog odgovarajućeg usmjerenja

  • Interes za otkrivanjem i rješavanjem problema

  • Komunikativna ste i organizirana osoba

  • Orijentiran na detalje i pouzdan zaposlenik

  • Profesionalizam, želju za učenjem i uklapanjem u korporativni sustav

  • Spremnost na rad u smjenama

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Poticajno radno okruženje

  • Redovita primanja

  • Mjesečni dodatak za prehranu

  • Djelomično pokriveni troškovi prijevoza

  • Mjesečna nagrada za radne rezultate

  • Ugovor o radu na neodređeno radno vrijeme uz probni rad od 6 mjeseci.

  • Početna plaća (tijekom probnog rada) 1.550€ BRUTO - mogućnost povećanja plaće ovisno o usvojenim znanjima, vještinama i samostalnosti u radu

  • Povećan broj dana godišnjeg odmora s obzirom na jubilarni staž i broj djece do 15 godina starosti

  • Božićnica, uskrsnica, regres, dar za djecu

  • Poklon bon za novorođenče

  • Jubilarne nagrade

  • Jasna mogućnost napredovanja kroz preuzimanje odgovornijih i kompleksnijih zadataka

  • Preuzimanje zanimljivih, izazovnih ali istovremeno zahtjevnih i odgovornih poslovnih zadataka

  • Mogućnost stjecanja novih znanja i osobnog razvoja

  • Sigurno i stabilno radno okruženja

  • Ravnotežu privatnog i poslovnog života

  • Mentorska podrška

  • Svježe voće za zaposlenike

  • Dva besplatna topla napitka dnevno po zaposleniku

  • Mogućnost punjenja električnih automobila (punionica na lokaciji)

  • Osigurana i profesionalno održavana radna odjeća (pranje i zamjena organizirani od strane poslodavca)

  • Bonus za preporuke (kada zaposlenik preporuči novog zaposlenika koji se zaposli)

POČETAK RADA I RADNO VRIJEME

  • Početak rada novih zaposlenika je 1. prosinca 2026.

  • Radi se u turnusima od 12 sati, od ponedjeljka do petka, uz rotaciju tri smjene.

title: SAVJETNIK (VODITELJ RAČUNOVODSTVA)/ SAVJETNICA (VODITELJICA RAČUNOVODSTVA)
employer: DOM ZA STARIJE I NEMOĆNE OSOBE VARAŽDIN
description:
Uvjeti:
  • završen specijalistički diplomski stručni ili diplomski sveučilišni studij, odnosno integrirani preddiplomski i diplomski sveučilišni studij ekonomije,
  • četiri godine radnog iskustva u struci,
  • vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
Probni rad u trajanju 6 mjeseci. Uz zamolbu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika domovnice),
  • dokaz o stručnoj spremi (preslika diplome),
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (dokaz o radnom stažu, ne starije od 30 dana),
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 30 dana),
  • preslika vozačke dozvole.
Svi dokumenti prilažu se u neovjerenim preslikama. Izabrani kandidat dužan je prije sklapanja ugovora o radu predočiti izvornike dokumenata na uvid. Za sve kandidate ne smije postojati zapreka iz članka 261. Zakona o socijalnoj skrbi (NN 18/22, 46/22, 119/22, 71/23, 156/23, 61/25), što provjerava poslodavac. Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, odnosno priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju. Pismene prijave na natječaj podnose se u roku od 8 dana od objave u Narodnim novinama, osobno ili poštom na adresu: Dom za starije i nemoćne osobe Varaždin, Zavojna 6, 42000 Varaždin, s naznakom „Natječaj za zapošljavanje – SAVJETNIK/CA (VODITELJ/ICA RAČUNOVODSTVA)“. Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su izričito suglasni da Dom za starije i nemoćne osobe Varaždin kao voditelj obrade osobnih podataka može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka. Ustanova pridržava pravo ne izvršiti izbor kandidata po ovom natječaju, bez obrazloženja kao i pravo poništenja natječaja u cijelosti ili jednom njegovom dijelu. O rezultatu izbora kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem internet stranice poslodavca u roku od 30 dana od dana isteka roka za podnošenje prijava. Napomena: Natječaj se objavljuje u Narodnim novinama te rok za prijavu počinje teći sljedećeg dana od objave u Narodnim novinama.

title: DOCENT/DOCENTICA IZ ZNANSTVENOG POLJA ELEKTROTEHNIKA
description:
Sveučilište u Rijeci TEHNIČKI FAKULTET raspisuje NATJEČAJ za izbor
  • jednog nastavnika na znanstveno-nastavno radno mjesto docent, u radnom odnosu na neodređeno vrijeme s punim radnim vremenom, za znanstveno područje Tehničke znanosti, znanstveno polje Elektrotehnika, za rad na Zavodu za automatiku i elektroniku.
Pisanoj i potpisanoj prijavi na natječaj se prilaže:
  1. životopis,
  2. prikaz znanstvene, nastavne i stručne djelatnosti,
  3. odluke o prethodnom izboru/reizboru na radno mjesto/u naslovni izbor nastavnika (ako pristupnik posjeduje),
  4. dokaz o odgovarajućoj stručnoj spremi (akademski stupanj doktora znanosti u odgovarajućem znanstvenom području i polju),
  5. popis radova i relevantne radove,
  6. dokaze o ispunjavanju kriterija sukladno Nacionalnim sveučilišnim, znanstvenim i umjetničkim kriterijima (NN 42/26.),
  7. važeći dokaz o državljanstvu (hrvatskom ili drugom).
Kandidati na natječaju moraju ispunjavati kriterije za znanstveno-nastavna radna mjesta propisane Zakonom o visokom obrazovanju i znanstvenoj djelatnosti (NN 119/22. i 110/26., članci 39. i 40.) i Nacionalnim sveučilišnim, znanstvenim i umjetničkim kriterijima (NN 42/26.). Probni rad je šest mjeseci. Na natječaj pod jednakim uvjetima mogu se prijaviti osobe obaju spolova. Pojmovi koji imaju rodni značaj koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod. Kandidati kojima hrvatski jezik nije materinji jezik moraju priložiti dokaz o poznavanju hrvatskog jezika (razina B2) prema Zajedničkom europskom referentnom okviru za jezike. Kandidati koji su stekli obrazovanje izvan Republike Hrvatske, moraju dostaviti obrazloženo mišljenje nadležne agencije o inozemnoj obrazovnoj kvalifikaciji. Kandidati koji se na temelju posebnih propisa - Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.), članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21.), članka 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 02/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), članka 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.), pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, obvezni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo te priložiti sve dokaze koje posebni propisi propisuju za ostvarivanje tog prava. Navedeni kandidati ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju u odnosu na ostale kandidate, samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17., 98/19., 84/21, 156/23.), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti svu potrebnu dokumentaciju predviđenu člankom 103. predmetnog Zakona, prema popisu na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti svu potrebnu dokumentaciju predviđenu člankom 49. predmetnog Zakona, prema popisu na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) u prijavi na natječaj dužni su se pozvati na to pravo te priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu. Dokazom o invaliditetu smatraju se javne isprave o invaliditetu na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom koji se vodi pri Hrvatskom zavodu za mirovinsko osiguranje https://mrosp.gov.hr/najcesca-pitanja-i-odgovori-7348/zakon-o-profesionalnoj-rehabilitaciji-izaposljavanju-osoba-s-invaliditetom-7475/pod-kojim-uvjetima-osobe-s-invaliditetom-ostvarujuprednost-pri-zaposljavanju-7477/7477 Prijavom na natječaj, kandidati natječaja su izričito suglasni da Tehnički fakultet, Sveučilišta u Rijeci kao voditelj zbirke osobnih podataka može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno važećim pozitivnim pravnim propisima. Prijave se podnose najkasnije u roku od 30 dana od raspisivanja natječaja u Narodnim novinama. Prijave na natječaj i traženi prilozi u skeniranom obliku dostavljaju se isključivo putem elektroničke pošte, u PDF formatu na adresu: pisarnica@riteh.uniri.hr Fakultet pridržava pravo provesti testiranje kandidata, a o čemu će kandidati koji su predali pravovremene i potpune prijave, koje udovoljavaju svim formalnim uvjetima natječaja biti naknadno obaviješteni. Kandidati koji se ne odazovu razgovoru pred povjerenstvom i/ili testiranju gube status kandidata i mogućnost sudjelovanja u daljnjem kvalifikacijskom postupku.
