title: Product Owner Salesforce (m/f/d) (Product Owner)
description: As worldwide experts in filtration, MANN+HUMMEL develop solutions for vehicles, industrial applications, clean air inside vehicles and the sustainable use of water. With team spirit and an open culture of communication, we are continuously working towards achieving our vision of ‘leadership in filtration'. Become part of our team.Role SummaryAre you looking for a new challenge beyond managing requirements and maintaining systems? Do you have the credibility and confidence to engage with senior leaders and international stakeholders, challenge priorities, and drive decisions? If so, this could be the ideal opportunity for you.As a Product Owner Salesforce, you will take global ownership of our Salesforce landscape within the Life Science & Environment Division (LS&E). Acting at the intersection of Business, Sales, and IT, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our CRM processes. In this highly visible position, you will work closely with international leaders and key decision-makers across our Water & Air Filtration business units.Your Challenge- Own the product strategy and roadmap for our global Salesforce platform within the Life Science & Environment (LSE) Division and serve as the central point of contact for all Salesforce-related topics.- Prioritize requirements from a diverse stakeholder landscape and translate business needs into a clear product vision and roadmap.- Continuously develop and enhance global Salesforce processes, governance structures, and standards while driving the standardization and harmonization of CRM and sales processes across regions and functions.- Drive Salesforce user adoption and ensure the platform delivers measurable business value to its users.- Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for optimization across the entire customer journey and sales process.- Act as the key interface between Business and IT, collaborating closely with Salesforce Architects, Administrators, and international project teams.- Support global rollouts and transformation initiatives, ensuring sustainable implementation and long-term success across the organization.- Bring forward innovative ideas and proactively drive the continuous evolution of our Salesforce ecosystem.Your Profile- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Business Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.- Professional Experience: Several years of professional experience as a Salesforce Product Owner, Salesforce Consultant, CRM Product Owner, Salesforce Business Analyst, CRM Manager, or in a comparable role.- Technical & Professional Expertise: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud and a deep understanding of CRM and sales processes.- Proven track record in international transformation, rollout, or digitalization projects.- Ideally, practical experience in sales or a sales-related function, enabling you to understand user challenges and translate them into valuable business solutions.- Experience in requirements management and the prioritization of complex stakeholder landscapes.- Ability to balance strategic objectives with operational execution and deliver tangible results.- Languages: Business fluent English skills; additional languages are considered an advantage.- Personality: Strong presence and the ability to operate confidently in an environment with high expectations and diverse stakeholder interests.- Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with senior leaders.- Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, whether defining a product roadmap or detailing specific business requirements.- High level of initiative, ownership, and drive, paired with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.- Passion for change, continuous improvement, and creating meaningful business impact.Diversity and inclusion are part of our DNA. We select solely based on the best talent. We therefore welcome applications from all individuals regardless of age, gender, origin, ethnicity, disability, or any other characteristics protected by law.Social Benefits- You will work with a high degree of independence and decision-making freedom- Performance-based pay and comprehensive benefits- 35 hours per week with flexitime or trust-based working hours (depending on the position) plus 30 days of vacation- Option for hybrid working (4 days in Ludwigsburg, 1 day mobile; for employees with children under 12 years of age, the following applies: 3 days in Ludwigsburg, 2 days mobile)- Everyone has talent: Our talent management process supports you in your professional development- Company restaurant- Places in a private daycare center closeby (both for children under and over 3 years of age)- A modern company pension plan to supplement your statutory pension insurance- Additional private health insurance (e.g., supplementary dental insurance)- A large number of discounts in our corporate benefits portal (e.g., on vacations, fashion, insurance, etc.)- Mobility offers: subsidy for the Deutschlandticket, JobRad leasing, and e-charging stations in the free parking garage with company charging ratesIf you have any questions about this job posting, please contact our recruiting team. You can reach us at TalentAcquisitionGermany@mann-hummel.com. Please include the job title and location of the position you are interested in in your email. title: Consulent Werving & Selectie
description: - Je spreekt vloeiend Slowaaks en Pools en kunt je ook goed redden in het Nederlands of Engels voor overleg met collega's op kantoor. Beheersing Duitse taal is een pré.- Je hebt recente ervaring in de uitzendbranche of in internationale werving en selectie.- Je bent communicatief sterk, schakelt snel en hebt een goede dosis mensenkennis.- Je handelt pro-actief en gaat zelf actief opzoek naar kandidaten door verschillende social media kanalen en websites.- Je werkt zelfstandig en pakt graag zelf contact op met opdrachtgevers over aanvragen.- Je hebt ambitie om jezelf op korte termijn verder te ontwikkelen richting een coördinerende rol.- Geen minimale opleidingseisen, we kijken vooral naar wie je bent en wat je al hebt laten zien.Ben jij degene die moeiteloos schakelt tussen Slowaaks, Pools en Nederlands (of Engels) en krijg je energie van het opbouwen van een sterke flexpool? Dan hebben we bij Light Personeelsdiensten in Rotterdam een mooie uitdaging voor je.We groeien hard. Daardoor breiden we onze wervingsteams uit en zoeken we iemand die de Slowaakse en Poolse markt kent of de talen vloeiend spreekt en snapt wat er speelt bij kandidaten uit die landen. Je komt te werken in een hecht team waar korte lijnen geen loze kreet zijn maar de dagelijkse praktijk.Als Consulent Werving & Selectie ben jij straks het eerste aanspreekpunt voor nieuwe en bestaande kandidaten/ medewerkers. Je zet vacatures uit via de juiste internationale kanalen, voert intakegesprekken en zorgt dat mensen precies weten waar ze aan beginnen voordat ze op de werkvloer staan. Je bouwt stabiele flexpools op, houdt contact met je kandidaten en regelt dat alles administratief klopt.Bij onze organisatie werken wij als een team. Je komt de planner regelmatig tegen voor afstemming maar krijgt ook de ruimte om zelf contact te onderhouden met opdrachtgevers en aanvragen zelfstandig op te pakken en te organiseren. Dus heb je een proactieve instelling en wil je meer dan alleen werven? Dan pas je hier goed.Op termijn is er concreet uitzicht op doorgroei naar een coördinerende rol. We investeren liever in mensen die willen groeien dan dat we steeds nieuwe mensen zoeken.

title: Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d) ab sofort gesucht (Pflegefachmann/-frau (Altenpflege))
description: ++Was wünschen sich Pflegefachkräfte?++Wir haben uns wirklich intensiv mit dieser Frage auseinandergesetzt, um DICH für uns zu gewinnen.Dabei sind wir mit dem gesamten Team zu folgenden Punkten gekommen:  Aus unserer Sicht ist es wichtig, dass... - man noch Freizeit hat, dass "Frei auch Frei BLEIBT" - ein Dienstplan zeitig aushängt - man angemessen entlohnt wird (4.000€ + Zuschläge)- man, wenn man schon einspringen muss, einen finanziellen Bonus erhält - es in der Woche keine Teildienste gibt - es zu keiner Akkordarbeit oder Fließband-Abfertigung kommt - man sich neben der Tour auch im Büro einbringen kann - man nicht 12 Tage durchfahren muss - es 30 Tage Urlaub gibt - man stets einen festen Ansprechpartner hat - die Tür zur Führungsebene IMMER offen steht - es ein ECHTES Teamgefühl gibt & ein ECHTES Miteinander - man RESPEKT und WERTSCHÄTZUNG groß schreibt - es Weiter- und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten gibt und auch über Perspektiven immer gerne gesprochen wird - es flache Hierarchien gibt - es zusätzliche Bonbons gibt, wie etwa unsere Mastercard (nach Ablauf der Probezeit) und Vieles mehr :-)Und natürlich wäre ein tolles Auto auch nicht schlecht, dass du zur privaten Nutzung benutzen kannst, aber damit können wir (noch) nicht dienen. Wir finden, einen Versuch ist es Wert.  Wir freuen uns auf dich!  Dein Team vom Pflegedienst KUNDE

description: Wir suchen ab 15.12.2026 in unbefristeter Festanstellung:Erzieher (m/w/d)in Teilzeit (30 Stunden/Woche)Einsatzort: Einrichtung family, Limmatstraße 3, 81476 MünchenBei uns geht es ums Ganze: die ganze Familie, die von uns betreuten Kinder und Jugendlichen, das Team, Beziehung, Authentizität, Einsatzbereitschaft – und viel Herz.In unserer vollbetreuten, therapeutischen Wohngruppe arbeiten wir familienaktivierend. Das bedeutet für uns: Wir binden die Familie eng in jeden Schritt der Betreuung mit ein – und wir nehmen sie ernst. Wir sehen, was sie bereits können. Und unterstützen da, wo es Entwicklungspotential gibt. Dafür arbeiten die pädagogischen Fachkräften Hand-in-Hand mit den familientherapeutischen und psychologischenFachdiensten.Die Begegnungen mit Menschen aus verschiedenen sozialen Hintergründen macht unsere Arbeit bunt und dynamisch. Bei uns ist es nie starr und langweilig. Wir lernen täglich von- und miteinander. Themen sind selten vorhersehbar, da ist eine Portion Freude an Flexibilität und Neugierde wichtig. Neben der dynamischen Fallarbeit gibt es die strukturierte Büroarbeit.Unser interdisziplinäres Team, zu dem auch unsere (wichtige!) Haushaltshilfe gehört, ist unsere Superpower. Wir unterstützen uns, finden gemeinsam die besten individuellen Möglichkeiten für die von uns betreuten Kinder und Familien. In unseren wöchentlichen Team-Sitzungen bringen wir uns mit transparenten Updates auf Stand. Wir arbeiten in Tandems und eng verknüpft mit den Fachdiensten, so haben immer vier Fachkräfte den gleichen Kenntnisstand. Das ist auch wichtig, um im Urlaub oder krank die Arbeit in der Arbeit lassen zu können.Gemeinsam zu feiern ist uns wichtig! Kleine Entwicklungen der Beziehungsarbeit zwischen Mutter und Kind zum Beispiel. Und uns als Team für das, was wir gemeinsam schaffen.Intensives Einlassen und Begleiten bei gleichzeitig richtig guten Rahmenbedingungen: Wir haben eine sehr gute Personalausstattung, einladende Räumlichkeiten mit Zuhause-Charakter in einer innovativen wogeno-Genossenschaftsanlage mit Gemeinschaftsräumen und Dachterrasse. title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. The Information Security Officer closely cooperates with Cyber Security Specialists and other Information Security colleagues in audits, change management, incident coordination, awareness activities, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives. Reports to:Chief Information Security Officer. Key areas of accountability: Risk management and advisory:Identify, assess and document security risks across information processes, projects and technologies within assigned areas of responsibility.Provide constructive security advisory for inquiries related to areas of responsibility, applying established guidelines and escalating complex topics where needed.Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide clear guidance and support the development of pragmatic, risk-aligned solutions.Support mitigation planning by providing input on security risks, controls and improvement actions.Policy management:Write and update security policies, standards and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility.Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security policies, standards and procedures.Identify gaps in policies, standards and guidelines and propose improvements to reduce security risks. Security awareness:Promote security awareness by delivering training and championing Information Security objectives.Assess current security awareness maturity in assigned areas and use insights to drive targeted improvements and clear communication.Support the adoption of the right security behavior based on JBT Marel’s policies, standards and guidelines. Reporting, audits and operations:Report on security posture and incidents within assigned areas of responsibility.Participate in technical and non-technical audits, change management processes and incident coordination activities.Apply established guidelines to analyze and resolve routine security issues.Identify opportunities for control enhancement and process improvement in assigned areas of responsibility.Support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture and monitor advancements in Information Security best practices.Team contribution:Operate with moderate supervision and seek guidance where needed.Support onboarding or training of new team members when requested.Provide input to employee performance evaluations as needed.Competencies and Skills:     Relating and networkingPresenting and communicating informationWriting and reportingAnalytical thinkingCooperativePro-activeConceptual/forward thinkingThoroughnessStress managementPragmatic and risk-based mindsetProficient English writing and speakingLevel of Knowledge and Experience:Bachelor level in information management and auditing, IT/information security, computer sciences, or a suitable combination of formal education and experience.1 - 3 years of experience in information security, risk management, IT audit, technology governance or a related field.Basic understanding of risk management, security policy management, security awareness, incident coordination and control improvement.Knowledge of international security standards or frameworks, such as ISO 27001, IEC 62443, OWASP, CIS Controls, NIST or ISF Standard of Good Practice, is desired.Preferred: experience in working in an international/ global organization.Preferred: knowledge of the manufacturing industry and business model/processes.Why Join JBT Marel?Joining JBT Marel means becoming part of a global leader in food processing technology that is helping feed the world more sustainably. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple countries, work on strategic global initiatives, and have opportunities to develop your career in an innovative, purpose-driven organization committed to continuous improvement, customer success, and operational excellence. Interested?📧 Apply by clicking the link to access the vacancy on JBT Marel´s website: https://jbtm.wd108.myworkdayjobs.com/JBT_Marel_Career_Site/job/IS---Gardabaer/Information-Security-Officer--Junior-_25689.🌐 Learn more about us at: JBTMarel.com🔗 Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jbtmarel/Last application date is November 17, 2026. Join us - and help shape the future of maintenance excellence at JBT Marel.Use of Technology in Our Hiring ProcessJBT Marel uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support the review of applications.These tools help our recruiting teams identify skills and experience relevant to the role based on job-related criteria.All applications are reviewed by people, and AI is not used to make hiring decisions independently. We are committed to fair, consistent and inclusive hiring practices globally.

title: Engineering Manager
description: Fenris Creations is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the infrastructure engineering team behind EVE Online.EVE runs as a single shared universe, where every player has an opportunity to leave a mark on a 20-year running persistent game experience. Our game cluster spans our own datacenter hardware and AWS. Our tight-knit team owns this infrastructure end-to-end: servers and network gear in the racks, the cloud networks and Golang domain specific services in AWS, and the incident, change management, testing, alerting, automation, and budget processes that keep it all running.You'll lead the engineers who build and run that platform. You'll set technical direction, own reliability and cost, and stay close enough to the work to make good calls during an outage or a hardware refresh. This is a hands-on management role.The role is based in Reykjavík, Iceland. We are a hybrid office, and offer flexibility around which days are in-office and which can be worked remotely.Your Tasks:Lead the teamHire, coach, and grow infrastructure engineers. Run 1:1s, give performance feedback, and guide career growth.Set the team's priorities across new platform work, requests from game teams, operational load, and technical debt.Run planning with product owners and other engineering leads.Own reliabilityRun the incident management process: on-call rotations and expectations, escalation paths, alerting, and blameless postmortems.Guide production change management, setting policy on deployment reviews, maintenance windows, and rollback plans, and so on.Define and track SLIs and SLOs for core services and set team priorities in response.Own the platformGuide architecture for our on-premise datacenter and AWS environments, and how traffic moves between them.Oversee hardware lifecycle: procurement, bare-metal provisioning, firmware and OS updates, and decommissioning.Own network design and security across both environments, from Cisco routers and firewalls to VPCs, Transit Gateways, and access controls.Push for automation wherever possible, in provisioning, configuration, CI/CD, and observability, to minimize engineering TOIL.Own the budgetSet the cloud and on-premise infrastructure budgets, and forecast spend as the game grows.Manage vendor relationships and contracts with cloud, datacenter, CDN, and tooling providers.Find and deliver cost savings without trading away reliability.Your Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing protocols such as BGP, VLANs, firewalls, and router configuration.Experience leading incident response and building on-call and postmortem practices.Comfort reading and reviewing code in Golang or Python.Experience owning or forecasting an infrastructure budget.Strong technical writing and spoken communication skills in English — design docs, tradeoff analyses — and a track record of title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. Det är möjligheten att skapa något eget och samtidigt uppleva ett nytt land, en ny matkultur och en ny vardag.ANSÖKANRekryteringen genomförs av Wildcard Untap, som hjälper verksamheter inom hotell och restaurang att hitta kvalificerade specialister och ledare genom aktiv search, personlig dialog och professionellt omdöme.Skicka CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din gastronomiska filosofi till:jobb@wildcarduntap.comMärk ansökan: ”Head Chef – Reykjavík”Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Residential Care Worker
description: Are you passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of children? Do you thrive in a dynamic and supportive work environment? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs.No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs.  You will be part of a unique team who will work together to facilitate excellent practice and be part of rebuilding children’s lives. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism.    Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard.    Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment.    Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing.    Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures.    Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling.    Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care.    Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed.    Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery.    Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team.    Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members.    Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. Give and receive feedback on performance with colleagues and managers.    Maintain consistency in execution of childcare plans.    Complete and maintain accurate records and reports for each young person in line with statutory requirements and Ashdale Care policies and procedures.    Take on key worker duties including the handling of daily petty cash, accurately documenting receipts, securely storing money and valuable items and serving as a primary point of contact for professionals/family/young person.

Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs.No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs. You will be part of a unique team who will work together to facilitate excellent practice and be part of rebuilding children’s lives. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism.Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard.Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment.Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing.Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures.Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling.Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care.Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed.Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery.Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team.Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members.Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. Give and receive feedback on performance with colleagues and managers.Maintain consistency in execution of childcare plans.Complete and maintain accurate records and reports for each young person in line with statutory requirements and Ashdale Care policies and procedures.Take on key worker duties including the handling of daily petty cash, accurately documenting receipts, securely storing money and valuable items and serving as a primary point of contact for professionals/family/young person.

monitor and report on relevant metrics.•    Support the planning and delivery of company events, including required on-site marketing and promotional activity.•    Collaborate across marketing, client services and business development to ensure consistent communications and support business objectives.Core Competencies•    Strong copywriting, digital storytelling, editorial planning and brand communications skills.•    Working knowledge of social media, website content management, SEO/AEO, digital analytics and marketing automation tools.•    Ability to coordinate campaigns, manage several priorities and meet deadlines with a proactive, organised approach.•    Confident communication and stakeholder-management skills, with a client-focused and collaborative working style.•    Creative judgement, commercial awareness, curiosity and an interest in workplace culture and employee experience.•    Ability to use marketing data to assess performance, identify opportunities and recommend actions.•    Professional discretion, integrity and the ability to handle confidential information.Qualifications and Experience•    Minimum of 1–2 years’ professional experience in marketing, digital communications, content development or a related area.•    Relevant BA or BSc degree required; a relevant Master’s qualification is an advantage.•    Experience using HubSpot and working in a business-to-business (B2B) environment is an advantage.•    Excellent written and spoken English.Working RequirementsThe role involves regular computer-based, online and telephone work and occasional attendance at company events and client locations, as required. Exposure to audits, dispute resolution or advisory projects (e.g. supply chain, IP or restructuring) is advantageous.Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial and economic data.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical issues to non-technical stakeholders.Experience with TP databases (e.g. Capital IQ, RoyaltyStat or TP Catalyst) preferred.Proficiency in MS Office, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word.Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines and maintain high-quality work.Teamwork, leadership potential and willingness to coach junior colleagues.Proactive, detail-oriented and committed to keeping up with international tax and TP developments.Commercial awareness and understanding of how TP interacts with business strategy, risk and cost structures.This is a full-time position based in Dublin, with a 37.5-hour working week.

title: Residential Care Worker
description: Are you passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of children? Do you thrive in a dynamic and supportive work environment? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs.No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs.  You will be part of a unique team who will work together to facilitate excellent practice and be part of rebuilding children’s lives. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism.    Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard.    Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment.    Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing.    Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures.    Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling.    Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care.    Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed.    Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery.    Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team.    Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members.    Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. Give and receive feedback on performance with colleagues and managers.    Maintain consistency in execution of childcare plans.    Complete and maintain accurate records and reports for each young person in line with statutory requirements and Ashdale Care policies and procedures.    Take on key worker duties including the handling of daily petty cash, accurately documenting receipts, securely storing money and valuable items and serving as a primary point of contact for professionals/family/young person.

title: Experienced Veterinary Surgeon
description: Are you ready to work alongside exceptional veterinary professionals in a supportive, high-quality environment? At Village Vets, we take pride in our dedication to delivering the highest standards of animal care. Supported by a dedicated medical team who prioritise continuous upskilling and professional growth, you’ll have the opportunity to thrive in your role while expanding your expertise.Our ideal candidate will have a strong desire to work in a small animal practice and be highly motivated, hard-working, and a team player. In Village Vets we strive to provide the best standard of care to our patients and the best service to our clients. We are proud to support our staff with a comprehensive CPD program and we welcome and encourage any interest in further education.Responsibilities:•    Perform a range of surgical procedures, including routine spays/neuters, among others with confidence and precision•    Diagnose, treat and care for all patients to the standard upheld by Village Vets•    Investigate and treat cases within the practice as completely as possible within the practice before referring, according to the needs of the patient•    Assume full responsibility for patients, ensuring that care after-hours or after referral is appropriate and of the highest standard, and that handover of cases is done effectively•    Keep medical records up to date and accurate•    Prescribe and dispense medications correctly and safely, and help maintain adequate stock levels•    Communicate effectively with clients, giving estimates and relevant information on diagnostics and treatment plans to allow informed decision-making regarding treatment.•    Provide and maintain an outstanding client experience throughout the whole practice across all mediums (face-to-face, phone, email, social media, website etc.)•    Promote the Pet Health Plans and Pet Insurance to all clients to facilitate the highest level of veterinary care.•    Communicate effectively with the team in the clinic to ensure patients and clients are treated with the highest level of care and compassion, to the standard upheld by Village Vets•    Provide appropriate veterinary training to all staff in order to assist with best practice measures.•    Help maintain the appearance and daily running of the clinic to the standard upheld by Village Vets•    Ensure that all bills are priced correctly•    Maintain membership of the VCI and be familiar with the legislation affecting the practice of veterinary medicine in Ireland.•    Adhere to the guidelines of practice as stated in the VCI Guide to Professional Conduct and remain up to date with CPD requirements.•    Behave at all times in a manner which serves to instil confidence in our profession in the minds of the team, individual clients and the wider general public.•    Carry out any ad hoc veterinary or administrative duties that may arise through the normal course of the day within the clinic or as advised by head nurse/lead vet.•    Complete all tasks, duties and procedures efficiently and accurately.•    Be responsible for creating and maintaining an outstanding client experience throughout the whole team.Administrative duties:•    Complete referral letters and accompanying medical histories.•    Prepare all relevant paperwork for external laboratories.•    Complete pet passports where applicable.•    Sign off vaccination records.•    Complete insurance claim forms if and when necessary.While at work all staff are required to take care of their own health and safety and that of others who may be affected by their acts and omissions & co-operate with Village Vets policies and procedures. Knowledge & Skills  Specification for a Veterinary SurgeonCriteria    Essential    Desirable Professional/Technical Qualification    Current registration with VCIMVB or Equivalent    Further qualification specific to Veterinary trainingExperience & Job Knowledge    Interest in working in progressive practice as part of team    Previous 1-2 years' experience in a small animal veterinary practiceSkills & Competencies    Ability to investigate and treat clinical cases appropriately.Surgical skills appropriate to level of experience.Excellent communication skills (written & oral).Ability to work well in fast-paced environment.Excellent time management.Ability to make clinical decisions.Ability to work autonomously.Confident and competent decision-making skills.Ability to provide training and direction to others.Ability to work as part of a team.    Personal Qualities     Excellent standard of personal presentation.Professional, progressive approach to clinical diagnostics, treatment and care.Self-motivated to work independently without constant supervision.Trustworthy with a conscious approach to work.NB: This job description is developed to help you gain a better understanding of the job role and is by no means exhaustive.

title: Senior Loans Officer
description: Senior Loans OfficerThe Credit Union has grown strongly over the past number of years, both in the level of activity and in the complexity of its business. We are seeking to recruit an experienced, multi-skilled, hands-on Head of Credit with a proactive nature to join our Management Team and assist in the further development of our business.The Role:Reporting to the CEO, the Head of Credit is a key member of the Management Team and plays a crucial role in the operation and development of the lending function within the Credit Union. The Head of Credit has direct responsibility for the overall management of the lending department, loan book growth, meeting lending targets and fostering a culture of exceptional service to members while promoting responsible lending practices.The Head of Credit will safeguard the strong asset quality in the Credit Union’s existing and future loan book. This will involve the continual development and implementation of loan assessment procedures and practices to support credit underwriting decisions. The Head of Credit will assess and approve loans within limits set by the Credit Union and ensure that the lending function operates within the risk tolerance and appetite as set out in the Credit Union’s credit and risk management policies. The role will also involve managing key operational processes and procedures, drafting processes and procedures and improving the overall operational effectiveness of the department.Key responsibilities:•    Provide strong and proactive management of the lending department.•    Ensure the lending department delivers a high-quality service in an effective and efficient manner.•    Build and maintain a strong lending team through effective recruiting, training, coaching, mentoring and team building.•    Design, implement and monitor activities within the lending department.•    Manage the overall loan portfolio, including personal loans, business loans and other lending products.•    Monitor the portfolio's performance, credit quality, and risk exposure, and take appropriate actions to ensure its stability and value.•    Assess and underwrite loan applications including analysis of financial accounts and business plans where appropriate.•    Interview members in relation to their loan applications and borrowing capacity.•    Assist with the restructuring and refinancing of stressed loans, including negotiations with financial and legal advisers.•    Review and recommend changes to credit policies and procedures.•    Operate within agreed lending policies, limits, and other criteria.•    Ensure compliance with relevant financial services legislation and regulation.•    Identify, evaluate and recommend new lending opportunities in a manner that is consistent with the Credit Unions’ strategic and risk management objectives.•    Provide an effective and efficient approach to the business, looking for opportunities to deliver improvements and process enhancements.•    Act as a sounding board for team members and be available to answer more complex queries from staff members.•    Ensure that service delivery expectations are achieved, and commitments are delivered.•    Provide support and regular reports to the CEO, other members of the Management Team, the Credit Committee, and the Board of Directors on lending activities.The successful candidate would preferably have the following:       •    A minimum of five years relevant lending and underwriting experience in personal loans, mortgages, lending to self-employed individuals and small and medium sized enterprises.•    A degree in Finance, Business, or a related discipline.•    A minimum of a QFA qualification.•    Ability to assess, critically evaluate and interpret complex information and to identify key credit risk drivers.•    Excellent people management skills with the ability to lead, motivate and train team members.•    Excellence in verbal and written communication, reporting and interpersonal skills.•    Proficiency in ICT skills across various applications.•    Excellent organisational skills with demonstrable ability to develop and enhance work practices.•    Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team to deliver agreed targets.•    An appreciation and an awareness of the credit union ethos. Canvassing will disqualify Applications for the above position detailing education and experience should be made to killianconsulting@gmail.comThe Credit Union’s Data Privacy Statement can be accessed via the website

title: tecnico chimico
description: GI GROUP SPA, prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, per un'importante realtà industriale internazionale operante nel settore della produzione di apparecchiature ad alta tecnologia, ricerca un: Analista Chimico Responsabilità: Sviluppo metodi e validazione: sviluppare procedure analitiche per metalli (composizione bulk e tracce) con OES/XRF, combustione ed estrazione a caldo; e per metalli in soluzione dopo digestione con ICP-OES/ICP-MS. Pianificare ed eseguire validazione/verifica (accuratezza, ripetibilità/riproducibilità, linearità, range, selettività, robustezza, carryover, LOD/LOQ) e confermare la tracciabilità metrologica tramite CRM. Definire e mantenere i budget di incertezza di misura (preparazione campione, calibrazione, performance strumentale) in linea con applicazione e decision rule. Redigere e mantenere piani/report di validazione e documenti controllati (SOP/WI) con gestione revisioni e valutazione impatti delle modifiche; Data integrity e gestione dati: garantire acquisizione, elaborazione e reporting secondo procedure controllate (configurazione strumenti, audit trail, versioning, calcoli tracciabili). Eseguire review tecnica e validazione risultati (stato calibrazioni, conformità QC, integrità campioni, controlli di plausibilità). Gestire archiviazione sicura e recupero dei dati grezzi/record con leggibilità nel lungo periodo e accessi controllati. Gestire i dati in modo strutturato con LIMS e fogli validati applicando principi ALCOA++. Condurre indagini e azioni correttive per non conformità, eventi di data integrity o QC fuori specifica; implementare CAPA e verificarne l'efficacia; Esecuzione analisi chimiche avanzate: svolgere analisi con metodi validati, inclusa preparazione campioni (pesata, digestione, diluizione), calibrazione e verifiche QC. Preparare reagenti e standard con tracciabilità documentata; gestire CRM e soluzioni di riferimento (stoccaggio, etichettatura, scadenze). Eseguire controlli di routine e verifiche prestazionali; coordinare manutenzione e troubleshooting con fornitori. Assicurare gestione sicura di chimici e rifiuti (risk assessment, DPI, compliance ambientale e regole di sito); Reportistica e interpretazione risultati: preparare report di prova conformi (identificazione metodo, tracciabilità, stato QC, incertezza quando applicabile). Interpretare risultati per caratterizzazione materiali, monitoraggio corrosione, failure analysis e supporto al processo; comunicare conclusioni agli stakeholder. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda cliente ricerchiamo: Buying Planner La risorsa, inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Buying e in collaborazione con i Buyer e la Direzione Commerciale, supporterà le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e gestione operativa degli ordini, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione della disponibilità del prodotto, della rotazione delle scorte e della marginalità. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; Predisporre e mantenere aggiornata la reportistica relativa a ordini, budget impegnato, consegne, stock e performance di prodotto, fornendo analisi a supporto dell'Ufficio Buying e della Direzione Commerciale. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in discipline economiche, statistiche, gestionali, moda o affini. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di Buying Planning, Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising o Product Management, preferibilmente nel settore fashion retail. Conoscenza delle logiche di assortimento, pianificazione e gestione dello stock nel settore retail. Spiccata capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Utilizzo avanzato di Excel; gradita la conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo: approccio analitico e commerciale, capacità di lettura delle performance di prodotto, ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione, precisione, problem solving, Sede di lavoro: Palermo, Orari: Lun-Ven 8:30 - 13:00 / 14:30 - 18:00 CCNL Commercio Range Retributivo previsto: € 23.300 - € 27.000. For Ferrero Ardennes, a global leader in the confectionery industry, we are recruiting: ELECTRONICS MAINTENANCE TECHNICIANS / MAINTENANCE SUPERVISORS FOR FERRERO - BELGIUM At Ferrero's ARLON site you will find: Highly automated production lines and latest-generation Industry 4.0 technologies A solid, structured and merit-based organization that values strategic maintenance skills An international environment with many colleagues who have relocated from Italy and from all over the world The selected candidate will join the maintenance team (about 90 people) and will be responsible for routine, extraordinary, preventive/predictive and breakdown maintenance on automated systems within the Arlon production site. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro cliente è una realtà italiana solida e strutturata attiva nelle grandi opere/infrastrutture, con forte presidio su cantieri, impianti e mezzi , che ci ha incaricato di ricercare per la sede di Sondrio un/una SENIOR BUYER - Lavori/Servizi/Forniture | Grandi Opere/Infrastrutture (Sondrio) La risorsa riporterà al Responsabile Ufficio Acquisti e avrà il compito di assicurare l'attività di approvvigionamento di lavori, servizi e forniture in ambito grandi opere e infrastrutture pubbliche, in funzione delle esigenze produttive dei cantieri per la parte plant & equipment. Nello specifico, la risorsa: Gestisce l'albo fornitori: selezione, aggiornamento e proposta di approvazione in linea con procedure interne. Prepara e invia le richieste di offerta, raccoglie le proposte e coordina le verifiche tecniche con le funzioni richiedenti. segue la negoziazione economica e contrattuale (tempi, condizioni, SLA), con attenzione a qualità, lead time e ottimizzazione costi. Desideriamo entrare in contatto con Senior Buyers in possesso di laurea in Ingegneria (Civile, Gestionale, Edile, Meccanica, dei Processi) oppure Diploma di Geometra con esperienza negli acquisti legati ai cantieri, in particolare su impianti e macchinari, materiali, ricambi e servizi (es. manutenzioni) e provenienza da contesti strutturati (ad es società di infrastrutture/costruzioni, EPC contractors, Oil & Gas, aziende produttrici di mezzi di movimentazione/sollevamento). È richiesta la conoscenza della normativa sugli Appalti Pubblici, una buona padronanza del pacchetto Office (soprattutto Excel) e, preferibilmente, familiarità con sistemi ERP (SAP). Completano il profilo autonomia operativa, capacità di lavorare in team e orientamento al risultato. Sede di lavoro: Sondrio con smart working 8 gg/mese. È richiesta motivazione al trasferimento; è previsto un pacchetto di relocation (inclusa foresteria, contributo spese viaggio) Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. Invitiamo chi si candida a leggere l'informativa privacy ai sensi degli artt. 13 e 14 del Reg. EU 679/2016 al seguente indirizzo https://it.wyser-search.com/privacy-policy/. #LI-AM

title: ingegnere meccanico
description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know? Some travelling will be expected within EMEA, Africa, etc What we can offer to you: Permanent Contract, CCNL Energia e Petrolio For home office contract: Pay not lower than 43000€ Corporate Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, internal gym, discounts and partnerships, services related to health, family, well-being, and in-house cafeteria. Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. RAL indicativa 70-80k + bonus variabile 10% Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. La risorsa, riportando al Purchasing Manager, opererà trasversalmente sugli stabilimenti italiani con impatto diretto su continuità produttiva, governance della spesa tecnica e performance dei fornitori. Collaborerà quotidianamente con Engineering, Manutenzione e Plant Management, oltre che con Qualità/HSE, Finance e Legal. Gestirà relazioni con fornitori italiani e internazionali (OEM, integratori, service provider) e, per investimenti o accordi quadro rilevanti, supporterà l'escalation verso General Management e Proprietà. È possibile un contributo su iniziative corporate di standardizzazione/razionalizzazione con estensione internazionale. Principali responsabilità: Gestione end-to-end del sourcing su CAPEX, servizi tecnici e MRO: dal fabbisogno alla contrattualizzazione Impostazione e conduzione di RFQ/RFP e gare, con comparativi tecnico-economici e analisi TCO Negoziazione di condizioni commerciali e contratti (garanzie, penali, tempi di consegna, collaudi/accettazioni, ricambi e service) Definizione e gestione di accordi quadro e contratti di service con SLA/KPI, aumentando la copertura contrattuale della spesa ricorrente Vendor management: qualifica, monitoraggio performance, gestione criticità/claim, mitigazione rischi (lead time, single source, continuità assistenza) Supporto a Engineering/Manutenzione su standardizzazione, ricambistica critica e iniziative di miglioramento Competenze tecniche richieste: Diploma tecnico (Perito Meccanico/Meccatronico) e/o Laurea in Ingegneria (preferenza Meccanica/Meccatronica/Industriale) Esperienza indicativa 5-10+ anni in acquisti tecnico-industriali in contesti manifatturieri strutturati Esposizione concreta a CAPEX e contrattualistica service, oltre a categorie MRO (ricambi, consumabili, manutenzioni) Familiarità con tendering strutturato, logiche TCO e disciplina di processo Buona padronanza di ERP/strumenti di procurement Inglese fluente per negoziazione e gestione fornitori internazionali Competenze manageriali e soft skills: Negoziazione evoluta e capacità di gestire trade-off costo/qualità/rischio/continuità Autorevolezza con stakeholder tecnici, forte orientamento all'execution e gestione priorità in contesto produttivo Comunicazione sintetica e capacità di escalation strutturata Approccio data-driven, rigore e affidabilità Sede di lavoro: Italia, area Emilia-Romagna, con trasferte prevalentemente nazionali e, in funzione dei progetti, internazionali. Attività prevalentemente on site. Offerta: inserimento a tempo indeterminato. Package indicativo: RAL €45.000-€55.000 + MBO ~10%. title: Database and network professionals
description: Il nostro cliente è uno dei principali System Integrator italiani specializzati in Networking, Data Center, Security e soluzioni Cloud, con una forte componente di progettazione infrastrutturale e una lunga storia nel mondo delle telecomunicazioni. Ci ha incaricati di ricercare un/a Senior Pre Sales Engineer - Networking che verrà inserito/a all'interno della Technology Unit NDCS della Business Unit PPS (Public & Private Sector) e opererà nell'area di Prevendita, contribuendo alla definizione di soluzioni innovative in ambito Networking, Data Center, Security e Cloud per clienti Enterprise e Pubblica Amministrazione. L'obiettivo del ruolo è supportare le strutture commerciali nella qualificazione delle opportunità, nella progettazione delle soluzioni e nella predisposizione delle offerte tecnico-economiche, collaborando con vendor, partner e team di delivery. Principali responsabilità - Supportare le attività di prevendita tecnica nell'ambito di gare, offerte e opportunità - commerciali in tecnologia multivendor. - Analizzare i requisiti tecnici e di business dei clienti. - Definire architetture e soluzioni infrastrutturali in ambito Networking e Data Center. - Predisporre documentazione tecnica, High Level Design, allegati di gara e documenti di - offerta. - Collaborare alla definizione della soluzione economica e alla stima degli effort progettuali. - Interfacciarsi con vendor e distributori. - Supportare PoC, workshop, demo e presentazioni tecniche. - Collaborare con Delivery e Operation. - Contribuire all'evoluzione dell'offerta aziendale. - Supportare il coordinamento tecnico di offerte complesse. Competenze tecniche richieste - Architetture IP Enterprise e Service Provider. - Routing e switching (OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, MPLS, Segment Routing). - Tecnologie LAN, WAN e Data Center. - Esperienza su soluzioni Cisco, HPE ed altri vendor. - SD-WAN e SDN. - Wireless Enterprise. - Cloud e Network Security. - Processi ITIL e Service Management. Requisiti - Esperienza di almeno 8-10 anni in attività specifiche nel ruolo di cui al profilo richiesto - Esperienza nella definizione di soluzioni complesse. - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. - Disponibilità a trasferte. Sede di Lavoro: Milano CCNL Metalmeccanico, Livello B3 O Quadro A1 RALT (fisso + variabile): 70.000€ SW fino al 50%, Ticket da 9 euro. Possibilità di auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo La nostra organizzazione opera nel rispetto della parità di genere e con l'impegno di sostenere l'inclusività e la diversity. Invitiamo a sottoporre le candidature evitando di fornire informazioni relative a matrimonio, gravidanza, responsabilità familiari, stato di famiglia. #LI-AM2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento.
